title: Abyssals v0.90.17 — The Botrune Verdicts
notes: Botrune now opens on the Gothic main street before the execution square. Each prisoner receives a verdict; witnesses contest the false charges, and guards hesitate only when they recognise Pate and Trade. Revised execution comics and explicit deaths, more natural dialogue, and an angry aftermath with Chaplain Walter. All six execution nursery gifts receive +15 percentage points of growth in every stat and a fixed 25% shiny chance. Existing gifts upgrade once without duplicate payouts or reviving lost partners. Existing saves, death history, Quickbite/fishing, Android package and original signing certificate preserved. Automated source/browser checks; no physical-phone testing.
